kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by [15]%.

Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [(40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (2.5)] physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back.

builds.name: Relentless Force: AP-scaling physical punch
builds.summary: Investigate high one Relentless Force enhanced attack core output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Relentless Force enhanced attack core output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The enhanced attack tooltip is 10/30/50/70/90 + 1.1 total AD + 1.0 AP physical damage to the target and enemies behind it. That expression already contains the attack AD contribution; adding another full basic attack would double count. Critical behavior may differ between the direct target and the cone and needs separate testing.
